data: Driss, pas vingt ans, vit de petits rackets et d’expédients. Il croise la route de Danny, voleur fatigué, qui arpente les zones commerciales au volant de sa vieille Merco. Sous la houlette de Danny, le jeune Driss, frimeur et naïf, fait ses classes et apprend quelques ficelles. Le monde violent où l’emmène peu à peu le vieux truand va mettre un terme à l’insouciance du jeune homme... (Driss, not yet twenty years old, makes a living from petty theft and racketeering. He crosses paths with Danny, an older, worn out thief who cruises shopping malls behind the wheel of his old Merc. Under the leadership of Danny, young Driss, a naive show-off, learns the tricks of the trade. The violent world into which the old crook slowly leads him puts an end to Driss' carefree existence.)

Driss, not yet twenty years old, makes a living from petty theft and racketeering. He crosses paths with Danny, an older, worn out thief who cruises shopping malls behind the wheel of his old Merc. Under the leadership of Danny, young Driss, a naive show-off, learns the tricks of the trade. The violent world into which the old crook slowly leads him puts an end to Driss' carefree existence.
